title: Balance & Bite's Thai Beef Salad
ingredients: Protein & Base: 300g scotch fillet, 100g vermicelli noodles, 1/2 cup white rice
Produce: 1 cos lettuce, 2 punnets cherry tomatoes halved, 1/2 bunch Thai basil, Vietnamese mint & coriander
Dressing: 1/4 cup fish sauce, 2 limes juiced, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 clove garlic, 2 green chillis
Pantry: 1 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper
steps: Toast rice in a dry pan over medium-high heat for 3-5 mins, let cool, then grind into coarse powder.
Heat dry pan on high. Season steak with salt, pepper, and olive oil, then sear 2-3 mins per side. Rest.
Grind garlic and chillis into paste, then mix with lime juice, fish sauce, and sugar for dressing.
Toss lettuce, noodles, tomatoes, and herbs in a large dish. Slice steak and place on top.
Drizzle with dressing, scatter with toasted rice powder, and serve immediately.
